mapper.select: SELECT * FROM api_test_collections WHERE project = #{project} AND name = #{name} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_test_collections (id, project, name, description, enabled, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{project}, #{name}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE api_test_collections SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, enabled = #{enabled}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM api_test_cases WHERE collection_id = #{collectionId} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, name ASC
